name: YMCA Camp Abnaki Day Camp
description_short: A weekday day camp for boys who have completed kindergarten through grade 4, held at YMCA Camp Abnaki in North Hero, VT. Boys swim, play group games and try activities like archery and arts and crafts, then go home each evening. Lunch, an afternoon snack and a bus from South Burlington are included.
refund_policy_summary: The $100 deposit for each session is non-refundable. Fees paid before the May 1 deadline are refunded, minus the deposit. After May 1, all payments are non-refundable, though the Camp Director may approve a pro-rated refund for a long illness or an accident. Cancellations must be made in writing. Homesickness, head lice and dismissal for behavior do not qualify for a refund.
swim_waterfront_notes: There is daily waterfront time (free swim or volleyball). Certified lifeguards supervise all aquatic activities. The shore is rocky and has zebra mussels, so sandals or water shoes are strongly recommended.
